summary: Biblioteca central de modelos 3D de los seis personajes de Janus: se sube cada GLB una sola vez, se valida con 3D Forge y se sirve a las dashboards con aprobación visual del Founder.
externalIo: local filesystem under a private directory supplied by the host; no network
dataClassification: private GLB assets and review state; never stored in the public repository
invariants: Only the six canonical slots are accepted; the classic robot slot and approved dashboards stay untouched.
Every upload is inspected fail-closed by an injected GLB inspector (3D Forge in JANUS) before it is written.
A new upload is always pending_visual_review; only the Founder can approve it.
Surfaces for minors receive only approved models, never a pending one.
Files are content-addressed (SHA-256), idempotent and verified on every read.
The private directory must live outside the public repository.
Outputs of vendor generators are never authorized as training data.
reuseNotes: Create CharacterLibrary(privateDir, { inspector, repositoryRoot }) with inspector = { inspect: inspectForgeGlb, receipt: makeForgeReceipt } in the host; call admit() from an authenticated upload route, overview()/kidOverview() for listings, bytes() to serve a model and review() for the Founder's visual decision.
